psychological_meaning: Camouflage evokes feelings of concealment, security, and a connection to nature. It suggests adaptability and blending in, often associated with military contexts and the outdoors. It can also represent resilience and resourcefulness, as it speaks to the ability to thrive in various environments. The muted tones offer a sense of calm and stability.
